families.name: Heno
families.description: 5S rRNA-related SINE (SINE3/5S), originally described from Python molurus. Also known as SINE-1_Pmo in some annotations. Present in multiple Boidae species.

subfamilies.name: Heno
subfamilies.notes: 5S rRNA-derived SINE. 7,529 sear hits in E. jayakari. top100=57%, rand100=42%. Contains ambiguity codes (N) in tail region.

families.name: Oph
families.description: Ophidia-specific SINE family. Multiple subfamilies (oph1, oph2, oph3, oph_ae) found across snake genomes with moderate copy numbers.
families.notes: Discovered via SINEderella multi-genome analysis of snake genomes.

families.name: Squam1
families.description: tRNA-derived SINE family found across squamate reptiles. Originally described from Python molurus (SINE-1_Pmo). The Squam1 family has multiple subfamilies defined by tail divergence and body variation, with the highest copy numbers in Eryx jayakari.

subfamilies.name: sq1ej
subfamilies.notes: Typical Squam1 consensus from Eryx jayakari. Highest-copy subfamily (24,826 sear hits). 337 nt with characteristic L2-derived tail ending in CCTTTACCTTTA microsatellite repeat.

subfamilies.name: sq1ej1
subfamilies.notes: Shares 3-prime tail with sq1ej. Some polymorphism in tail region. 5,662 sear hits.

subfamilies.name: sq1ej3
subfamilies.notes: Different tail from sq1ej. Extremely variable microsatellite tail. Only 498 sear hits â€” lowest copy Squam1 subfamily.

subfamilies.name: sq1ej4
subfamilies.notes: Different tail from sq1ej. 1,402 sear hits.

families.name: Squam2
families.description: tRNA-derived SINE family in squamate reptiles. Low copy numbers in Eryx jayakari compared to Squam1/Squam3 families.

subfamilies.name: sq2_Eryx
subfamilies.notes: Eryx-specific Squam2 subfamily. Low copy number. Self-bitscore=855 (lowest of all 12 consensus sequences).

families.name: Squam3
families.description: tRNA-derived SINE family in squamate reptiles. Multiple Eryx-specific subfamilies (A, C, X) identified by SINEderella, each with distinct tail regions. High copy numbers comparable to Squam1.

subfamilies.name: Sq3A_Eryx
subfamilies.notes: Eryx-specific Squam3 subfamily. 24,844 sear hits â€” second highest copy number subfamily.

subfamilies.name: Sq3X_Eryx
subfamilies.notes: Eryx-specific Squam3 subfamily with different tail (poly-A). Highest copy number: 28,091 sear hits. Needs clarification â€” possible overlap with other Sq3 subfamilies.

families.name: SqUCON
families.description: SINE family of uncertain classification found in squamate reptiles. Two subfamilies identified (SqUCON and SqUCON1) with relatively low copy numbers.

subfamilies.name: SqUCON
subfamilies.notes: SINE of uncertain classification. 1,785 sear hits. High self-bitscore (2478) suggests well-conserved copies.

subfamilies.name: SqUCON1
subfamilies.notes: Variant of SqUCON with different tail motif (CTT repeat vs CCT repeat). Contains ambiguity codes (N, H). Copy count not determined from sear headers.
